title: Local Support Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.02126v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We explore catastrophic forgetting in the context of large pre-trained models. By considering forgetting as a geometric problem in the input space of each weight matrix, we uncover a natural retention objective under which updates produced by gradient-based optimizers are suboptimal. Following this observation, we propose Local Support Learning (LSL), a general-purpose framework that augments gradient-based training for retention of prior capabilities without access to prior data. During a new learning phase, LSL pairs two components with distinct roles: a standard weight adapter, trained as usual to minimize the loss, and a gating function that enables the adapter only on input activations from its own training distribution, making the update local to that distribution. The key challenge is that this gate must route data from all learning phases while training only on data from the current one. We address this with a gate based on a G

translated_abstract: 我们探讨了大型预训练模型背景下的灾难性遗忘问题。通过将遗忘视为每个权重矩阵输入空间中的一个几何问题，我们揭示了一个自然的保持目标，在该目标下，基于梯度的优化器所产生的更新是次优的。基于这一观察，我们提出了局部支撑学习（LSL），这是一种通用框架，通过对基于梯度的训练进行增强，在不访问先前数据的情况下保持模型的先前能力。在新的学习阶段，LSL 将两个具有不同角色的组件配对：一个标准的权重适配器，像往常一样训练以最小化损失；以及一个门控函数，仅在其自身训练分布的输入激活上启用该适配器，从而使更新局部化于该分布。关键挑战在于，该门控必须在仅使用当前阶段数据训练的情况下，对来自所有学习阶段的数据进行路由。我们通过一种基于 G…（原文截断）的门控方法来解决这一问题。
tldr: 该论文提出局部支撑学习（LSL）框架，将灾难性遗忘视为权重矩阵输入空间中的几何问题，通过权重适配器与门控函数的组合，在不访问旧数据的情况下增强基于梯度的训练，从而保持模型先前学到的能力。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Local Support Learning (LSL), a general framework that treats catastrophic forgetting as a geometric problem in the input space of weight matrices and pairs a weight adapter with a gating function to retain prior capabilities during gradient-based training without access to prior data.
